role: Single source of truth for all pricing on 3webobs.com. Every other representation (homepage, /pricing, FAQ visible text, FAQPage markup, OfferCatalog JSON-LD, capabilities.json, agent card, checkout) MUST be generated from this file. Divergence between this file and any published price is a bug, not a variant.
consumers: FAQ (visible Q&A text + FAQPage markup — must match word for word)

availability_rules.note: availability is not a free-text field. It reflects whether the delivery mechanism actually runs.
availability_rules.InStock: the mechanism that delivers this plan is live and verified
availability_rules.PreOrder: the plan is defined and priced but its delivery mechanism is not yet operational
availability_rules.monitoring_gate: All monitoring plans stay PreOrder until the hourly cron calling /cron-tick is confirmed running. When the cron is green, flip the three monitoring plans to InStock and delete the disclaimer in notices.monitoring_not_running from every page.

plans.name: Free reports
plans.rationale: Market convention, not a concession. 5 of 9 competing tools have a real free entry point.

plans.name: Additional report
deliverables: report hash recorded in the integrity manifest

plans.name: Monthly monitoring
deliverables: change alerts to a callback URL

plans.name: Weekly monitoring
deliverables: change alerts to a callback URL

plans.name: Daily monitoring
deliverables: change alerts to a callback URL

plans.name: Machine access (A2A / REST)
deliverables: raw JSON report: signal verdicts, evidence, scores, coverage, confidence
plans.price_parity_note: The 0.50 EUR price is defensible ONLY because the deliverable is strictly smaller than the 19 EUR human report. If the API ever returns a PDF, a public URL, a signed report or retained history, this price must move to parity with extra_report, otherwise the API becomes an arbitrage channel against the product itself.

plans.name: AI-READY implementation
deliverables: remediation of failed signals, not measurement of them
edge delivery of the machine-web signal layer
re-audit with delta against the baseline observation
plans.rationale: The positioning argument: competitors tell you whether you are cited. This tells you why you are not, and then fixes it.

integrity_rules: No monitoring plan may cost less per month than a single additional report. A monthly plan delivers at least one report, so pricing it below extra_report makes the standalone report irrational to buy.
The per-call API price and the per-report human price may differ ONLY while their deliverables differ. Same output, same price.
Volume packs must decrease monotonically in unit price.
Any plan whose delivery mechanism is not running is PreOrder, in this file and in schema.org, with no exception for pages that look better without the label.

notices.monitoring_not_running: Scheduled re-observation is not yet running. Monitoring plans are listed as pre-order.
notices.no_guarantee: An audit does not guarantee citation or ranking.
